Step 14 ran a BookStack search for 'ledger' (4 hits: 143, 150, 144, 139; lines 1540-1543) and step 15 listed book 122 (lines 1658-1691). It picked 6 turn-ledger pages (139, 143, 144, 147, 150, 152) and, following the ticket's hint, fetched each whole with its comments (steps 16-18, lines 1705-1774). That put 6 of the 8 wiki-comment remarks on disk (l14, g7r2-l14, l5, l11, g7r2-l07, g7r2-l13). It displayed only 150 (step 19) and 143 (step 20) before the run ended. end_reason: infra: the model stopped responding mid-research. After step 20's `cat /tmp/wiki/143.txt` (line 1880), steps 21 and 22 were empty assistant replies (lines 1977-1995). In the raw record, messages 41 and 43 have content '' and content_json null. Both times the harness replied 'Previous response had parsing errors: ... your previous reply contained no content at all', and after the second the episode ended. The verifier's junit timestamp (16:41:45.07Z) is 0.14 s after those messages were recorded (16:41:44.933Z). The agent had not set task_complete, had stated no intent to stop, and had just planned to read 144 next (line 1874). The last input was ordinary wiki text, and the model gave no refusal text even though the harness invited it. Both empty replies came within about 3 s of the previous step, which suggests an empty completion from the provider or harness rather than a long generation cut off at max_tokens (8000); the record carries no stop reason to settle it. Agent wall time was about 3 min 16 s (16:38:28 to 16:41:44). No file was edited, and the submission sha equals baseline 295ab6c ('nothing was pushed').
